sentences.text: Amitabh Harivansh Rai Shrivastava Bachchan -LRB- -LSB- əmɪˈtaːbʱ ˈbətʃːən -RSB- ; born 11 October 1942 -RRB- is an Indian film actor .

He first gained popularity in the early 1970s for movies like Zanjeer and Deewaar , and was dubbed India 's first `` angry young man '' for his on-screen roles in Bollywood .	Zanjeer	Zanjeer (1973 film)	Deewaar	Deewaar (1975 film)	Bollywood	Bollywood
Referred to as the `` Shahenshah of Bollywood '' , `` Star of the Millennium '' or `` Big B '' ,	Bollywood	Bollywood	Shahenshah	Shahanshah
he has since appeared in over 190 Indian films in a career spanning almost five decades .
Bachchan is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential actors in the history of Indian cinema .	Indian cinema	Cinema of India
So total was his dominance on the movie scene in the 1970s and 1980s that the French director François Truffaut called him a `` one-man industry . ''	François Truffaut	François Truffaut

Bachchan has won numerous accolades in his career , including four National Film Awards as Best Actor and many awards at international film festivals and award ceremonies .	numerous accolades	List of awards and nominations received by Amitabh Bachchan	National Film Awards	National Film Awards	Best Actor	National Film Award for Best Actor
He has won fifteen Filmfare Awards and is the most-nominated performer in any major acting category at Filmfare , with 41 nominations overall .	Filmfare Awards	Filmfare Awards
In addition to acting , Bachchan has worked as a playback singer , film producer and television presenter .	playback singer	playback singer
He has hosted several seasons of the game show , Kaun Banega Crorepati , India 's version of the game show franchise , Who Wants to Be a Millionaire ?	Kaun Banega Crorepati	Kaun Banega Crorepati
He also had a stint in politics in the 1980s .

The Government of India honoured him with the Padma Shri in 1984 , the Padma Bhushan in 2001 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2015 for his contributions to the arts .	Padma Vibhushan	Padma Vibhushan	Padma Bhushan	Padma Bhushan	Padma Shri	Padma Shri	Government of India	Government of India	the arts	the arts

The Government of France honoured him with its highest civilian honour , Knight of the Legion of Honour , in 2007 for his exceptional career in the world of cinema and beyond .	Government of France	Government of France	Legion of Honour	Legion of Honour
Bachchan made his Hollywood debut in 2013 with The Great Gatsby , in which he played a non-Indian Jewish character , Meyer Wolfsheim .	The Great Gatsby	The Great Gatsby (2013 film)
